provenance: The inputs were local explicit-partial ASCII DXF projections of the locally generated specification-directed AC1012 collision-and-unique-entry pair. ODA File Converter 27.10.0.0 generated the new DWGs in an offline emulated Ubuntu linux/amd64 container, then reopened them and exported R2010 ASCII DXF. No drawing was committed.

originalPair.odaResult: Both failed readFile with 'Object of class AcDbDimStyleTableRecord can't be cast to AcDbEntity'; no DXF was produced. Converter exit status alone did not signal the individual failures.

replacement.odaReopen: Both generated files reopened and re-exported without .err files. The independent DXF tag audit resolves ACAD_MLINESTYLE dictionary ownership and each target style and confirms the listed angles.
replacement.libredwg: GNU LibreDWG 0.14 independently read both DWGs successfully and reports the same dictionary entry handles, style owners and start angles.

limits: ODA generated and reopened its own DWGs; the independent LibreDWG read is not a native AutoCAD open or merge operation.
The chosen styles have zero elements; their acceptance and usability as merge witnesses in AutoCAD must be checked.
The ODA R2010 DXF group 281 value is not proof of an AC1012 source cloning field or AutoCAD's default merge semantics.
The source DXFs were explicit-partial projections; their successful use does not qualify whole-source lossless conversion.
